title: Remove Circular Dependencies
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

There were circular dependencies that were causing subtle bugs in runtime. 

This removes them, and adds a check in CI to prevent further additions.

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

No new dependencies are added on install.
[Madge](https://www.npmjs.com/package/madge) is a very popular package, that's only downloaded when the step is executed in the CI.

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.
- [ ] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/packages/mermaid/src/docs/community/development.md#3-update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [x] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch

## Polynomial regular expression used on uncontrolled data

This [regular expression](1) that depends on [library input](2) may run slow on strings with many repetitions of ' '.
This [regular expression](3) that depends on [library input](2) may run slow on strings starting with '%%' and with many repetitions of '%%'.
This [regular expression](1) that depends on [library input](4) may run slow on strings with many repetitions of ' '.
This [regular expression](3) that depends on [library input](4) may run slow on strings starting with '%%' and with many repetitions of '%%'.
This [regular expression](1) that depends on [library input](5) may run slow on strings with many repetitions of ' '.
This [regular expression](3) that depends on [library input](5) may run slow on strings starting with '%%' and with many repetitions of '%%'.
This [regular expression](1) that depends on [library input](6) may run slow on strings with many repetitions of ' '.
This [regular expression](3) that depends on [library input](6) may run slow on strings starting with '%%' and with many repetitions of '%%'.
This [regular expression](1) that depends on [library input](7) may run slow on strings with many repetitions of ' '.
This [regular expression](3) that depends on [library input](7) may run slow on strings starting with '%%' and with many repetitions of '%%'.

[Show more details](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/security/code-scanning/113)
comments.label_reasoning: Polynomial regular expressions used on uncontrolled (user/library) input can lead to ReDoS (Regular Expression Denial of Service) vulnerabilities, which is a security/logic defect due to catastrophic backtracking on crafted inputs.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Flags a ReDoS (Regular Expression Denial of Service) vulnerability caused by polynomial regex patterns applied to uncontrolled input. This implies the regex should be fixed or the input sanitized.
